name: Replication Data and Code for: Significant Subgraph Mining for Neural Network Inference with Multiple Comparisons Correction
description: Contains data and code underlying results presented in Gutknecht, Aaron J.; Wibral, M. (2021): "Significant Subgraph Mining for Neural Network Inference with Multiple Comparisons Correction".

distribution.name: effect_size_power_tarone.pkl
distribution.description:
Results of the detailed empirical power analysis for the n=60 case using the Tarone correction. This file is used in the 
empirical_power_analysis_n60_detailed.py script to load the results instead of calculating them (which may take roughly one hour).

distribution.name: effect_size_power_WY.pkl
distribution.description:
Results of the detailed empirical power analysis for the n=60 case using the Westfall-Young correction. This file is used in the 
empirical_power_analysis_n60_detailed.py script to load the results instead of calculating them (which may take several hours).

distribution.name: empirical_power_analysis_joint_dist_sim_n_60_tarone.pkl
distribution.description: Results of the empirical power analysis of the MEG data set. For each of the 400 simulations in the n=60 case the file contains all detected subgraphs using the Tarone correction. This file is loaded in the empirical_power_analysis_n60_detailed.py script.

distribution.name: empirical_power_analysis_joint_dist_sim_n_60_WY.pkl
distribution.description: Results of the empirical power analysis of the MEG data set. For each of the 400 simulations in the n=60 case the file contains all detected subgraphs using the Westfall-Young correction.

distribution.name: empirical_power_analysis_n60_detailed.py
distribution.description: Code underlying the detailed empirical power analysis of the n=60 case. Calculates the empirical detection for each subgraph in the original data set that occurs with different frequencies in the two groups.

distribution.name: network_samples_asd.pkl
distribution.description: Inferred transfer entropy networks in the autism spectrum group.

distribution.name: network_samples_cont.pkl
distribution.description: Inferred transfer entropy networks for the control group.

distribution.name: significant_subgraph_mining.py
distribution.description: Main implementation of significant subgraph mining.

distribution.name: significant_subgraph_mining_modified_power_analysis.py
distribution.description: Modified implementation of significant subgraph mining used for the detailed power analysis of the n=60 case. The difference is that the counts in each group are saved for each subgraph.

distribution.name: ssm_fwer_analysis_erdos_renyi.py
distribution.description: Coder underlying the family-wise error rate simulation based on Erdos-Renyi networks.

distribution.name: ssm_power_analysis_erdos_renyi.py
distribution.description: Coder underlying the power simulation based on Erdos-Renyi networks.

distribution.name: ssm_results_alpha_1_5.pkl
distribution.description:
Contains an enumeration of all subgraph in the original MEG data set that occur often enough to become significant. Is loaded in the 
empirical_power_analysis_n60_detailed.py script.

distribution.name: subgraph_mining_empirical_power_analysis_independent_links.py
distribution.description: Code underlying the empirical power analysis of the MEG data set assuming independent sampling of links.

distribution.name: subgraph_mining_empirical_power_analysis_joint_dist.py
distribution.description: Code underlying the empirical power analysis of the MEG data set based on resampling from the empirical joint distribution.

distribution.name: tarone_standard_errors.pkl
distribution.description: Standard errors of the estimator of the average detection probability of subgraphs with a given effect size in the MEG data set (using Tarone correction). Can be loaded in the empirical_power_analysis_n60_detailed.py script.

distribution.name: WY_standard_errors.pkl
distribution.description: Standard errors of the estimator of the average detection probability of subgraphs with a given effect size in the MEG data set (using Westfall-Young correction). Can be loaded in the empirical_power_analysis_n60_detailed.py script.
